author: Inside Edition
description: Kalee Weatherwax's kitchen is a whirl of activity as she kneads dough, presses it into loaf pans, loads the pans into the oven and takes them out again. The Augusta, Maine mother of two isn't just a hobby baker; her baked goods stock a stand outside her family's home, and whatever money it generates goes back to her family. Those funds help them pay for her son's chemotherapy medicine, which she says costs about $2,000 a box.
title: Maine Mom's Sourdough Bake Stand Helps Pay For Son's Chemo
